svg.title: Known-best packing of 90 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=90 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-15 exact rational centre-direction certificate at 90, read exactly from the retained source file n90/n90_exact.json at fa53fb0, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#997 names in place of #996's 64d5ee7: a local-search improvement of T-303, jazivxt's packing of issue 989. Finite construction feasibility only; the linear program's first-order statement, local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=90 known best: side ~ 9.994038767 (certified upper bound)
